text: 近日，在以“智能驱动 融合共生——智能经济新形态下的金融科技”为主题的2026金融街论坛年会金融科技大会上，证监会副主席刘浩凌指出，人工智能赋能资本市场高质量发展，要统筹好发展与安全，既不能因技术红利漠视风险，也不能因风险止步不前。要完善综合治理体系，建立健全准入评估、动态监测、应急处置等全生命周期管理。要积极探索符合我国资本市场实际的人工智能治理路径，科学划定高价值应用场景的边界和风险容忍尺度，探索建立符合业务实际需求的可信度评估体系。要主动融入国家人工智能发展大局，强化与产业界、科研院所协同联动，汇聚发展合力。（证券时报）
text_en: Recently, at the Fintech Conference of the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting, held under the theme "Intelligence-Driven, Integrated Coexistence—Fintech in the New Form of the Intelligent Economy," Liu Haoling, Vice Chairman of the CSRC, noted that AI empowers the high-quality development of the capital market, and development and security must be coordinated. We must neither ignore risks because of the technology dividend nor halt progress because of risks. We should improve the comprehensive governance system and establish and perfect full-lifecycle management including access assessment, dynamic monitoring, and emergency response. We should actively explore an AI governance path that suits the reality of China's capital market, scientifically define the boundaries and risk tolerance levels of high-value application scenarios, and explore the establishment of a credibility assessment system that meets actual business needs. We should proactively integrate into the overall national AI development agenda, strengthen coordination and linkage with industry and research institutes, and pool development synergies. (Securities Times)
